## VetsEZ - Backend Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://vetsez.breezy.hr/p/04c563f2b91e01-backend-engineer-remote-opportunity)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Backend Engineer building secure Java and Spring Boot services for federal healthcare modernization. Developing APIs, integrations, and scalable cloud-ready solutions in Agile teams.
Backend Engineer building secure Java services for federal healthcare modernization
- Tech stack: Java, Spring, Spring Boot, SpringBoot, SQL
- Develop and maintain backend services, RESTful APIs, and enterprise integration components for shared services and mission-critical healthcare applications
- Implement business logic, service orchestration, data access layers, and secure service-to-service communication
- Build scalable, maintainable, and secure server-side solutions using approved architectures, development standards, and secure coding practices
- Collaborate with frontend developers, architects, QA engineers, DevSecOps teams, and product stakeholders in an Agile delivery environment
- Participate in technical design, estimation, code reviews, troubleshooting, defect resolution, release activities, and production support
- Optimize backend service performance, reliability, error handling, monitoring, logging, and observability
- Support sprint, increment, and release priorities across healthcare applications
- Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and project success
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience
- Minimum of 5 years of backend software engineering or enterprise application development experience
- Strong hands-on experience developing backend applications using Java, Spring Boot, RESTful services, and API development principles
- Experience with SQL, relational databases, data access layers, and backend data processing patterns
- Experience with enterprise integration patterns, authentication methods, secure service-to-service communication, Git-based version control, and CI/CD workflows
- Strong debugging, troubleshooting, analytical, and code quality skills
- Understanding of secure coding and enterprise software development best practices
- Ability to collaborate across engineering, QA, DevSecOps, architecture, and product teams within Agile delivery environments

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Backend Engineer building secure Java and Spring Boot services for federal healthcare modernization. Developing APIs, integrations, and scalable cloud-ready solutions in Agile teams.
Backend Engineer building secure Java services for federal healthcare modernization

• Develop and maintain backend services, RESTful APIs, and enterprise integration components for shared services and mission-critical healthcare applications
• Implement business logic, service orchestration, data access layers, and secure service-to-service communication
• Build scalable, maintainable, and secure server-side solutions using approved architectures, development standards, and secure coding practices
• Collaborate with frontend developers, architects, QA engineers, DevSecOps teams, and product stakeholders in an Agile delivery environment
• Participate in technical design, estimation, code reviews, troubleshooting, defect resolution, release activities, and production support
• Optimize backend service performance, reliability, error handling, monitoring, logging, and observability
• Support sprint, increment, and release priorities across healthcare applications
• Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and project success
Role requirements:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience
• Minimum of 5 years of backend software engineering or enterprise application development experience
• Strong hands-on experience developing backend applications using Java, Spring Boot, RESTful services, and API development principles
• Experience with SQL, relational databases, data access layers, and backend data processing patterns
• Experience with enterprise integration patterns, authentication methods, secure service-to-service communication, Git-based version control, and CI/CD workflows
